description: This file contains a jQuery plugin for animating numbers, including functions for formatting numbers, converting strings to numbers, and animating number changes when elements are in the viewport.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with specified decimal places, thousand separator, and decimal separator.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts a formatted string to a number, removing thousand separators and replacing decimal separator.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Recursively updates the element's HTML to animate number change.

methods.name: isInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is within the current viewport.
